verdict.rationale: Crossmint's Agent Checkouts API lets an agent take a merchant product URL and spending cap, initiate checkout, and complete an order end-to-end, backed by Agent Cards (order intent = delegated, scoped, revocable payment credential) or Agent Wallets (onchain-enforced delegated signer), matching the full checkout-session → delegated-credential → confirmed-order flow. Docs are detailed and first-party but there's no independent/hands-on corroboration, and the lifecycle is poll-only with no staging environment for testing. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of a completed order, staging/sandbox testing environment, and webhook-based (vs poll-only) order status confirmation.
